provenance.ref: engine probe: a response with a VALID v2 header AND the same v2 envelope mirrored in the body grades F with five core errors (VERSION_BODY_SAYS_V2 + a full v1 cascade), though every current client pays it via the header
@x402/core@2.23.0 chunk-BA2VL4DT.mjs:2042-2049 — header wins whenever present; the body is only consulted when no header exists

evidence: When no v2 header exists the core error is right (the dual client's body fallback demands x402Version===1, so a v2-only-in-body endpoint is unpayable), but the check fires unconditionally: probed a valid-header + v2-body response and it graded F although header-first clients pay it fine — the same class of fault as V1_BODY_NOT_ENVELOPE, which the catalog itself grades warn.

notes: Counts: 52 CONFIRMED, 7 MISCLASSIFIED (V2_MAX_TIMEOUT, V2_EXTRA_EIP712, V2_BAZAAR_INPUT, V1_MIMETYPE, V1_DESCRIPTION, V1_MAX_TIMEOUT, V1_EXTRA_EIP712 — all warns that are actually client-parse-breaking or scheme-spec-required), 5 OVERSTRICT (V2_PAYTO and V1_PAYTO grade conformant Solana/role-constant envelopes F; V2_BAZAAR_OUTPUT_EXAMPLE rejects the spec's own object-typed example; V1_DISCOVERABLE fires on absence though the reference extractor defaults discoverable to true; VERSION_BODY_SAYS_V2 grades F a dual-published v2 body despite a valid v2 header, probe-verified). Contested semantics adjudicated: (1) V2_ACCEPTS_V1_FIELDS — no real client/facilitator rejects strays: @x402/core's payment path is JSON.parse-only (no zod), the client echoes the accepts entry verbatim as `accepted`, and the server deep-equal compares symmetric objects; zod, where invoked, strips rather than rejects — the warn downgrade is CORRECT. (2) amount — atomic integer string confirmed at three layers: spec type string 'atomic units', BigInt() throw in @x402/evm signing, isInteger zod refine in the reference facilitator. (3) resource required set — spec/client require only url (NonEmptyString); description/mimeType/serviceName/tags/iconUrl optional; resource.method is NOT a spec field (ecosystem/CDP practice; the required home is bazaar.info.input.method per CDP validator). (4) bazaar for CDP indexing — REQUIRED: extension present, info, schema, info.input (+input.method matching probed verb), x402Version 2, 402 + header delivery, https absolute url, amount>=1000, maxTimeoutSeconds set; ADVISORY: output, output.example (cdp-validator capture + CDP seller docs; delisting on non-402 documented verbatim). (5) base64 — @x402/core tests /^[A-Za-z0-9+/]*={0,2}$/ BEFORE atob in decodePaymentRequiredHeader; url-safe is rejected pre-decode; the spec is alphabet-silent so client behavior governs. (6) version detection — payload x402Version wins over transport (discriminatedUnion + registry dispatch), verified in client source; header wins over body when both present. Biggest catalog risk found: the warn-tier v2 fields maxTimeoutSeconds and extra.{name,version} are in fact payment-breaking (zod-required / client-throw / BigInt-NaN), i.e. the catalog under-grades the two commonest silent-failure fields while over-grading Solana sellers.
